_comment: Minimal fixture for the LPC176x boot/connect smoke test. No analog_in / i2c / step_trigger entries - the test just verifies that the firmware boots through SystemInit (LPC_SC stub at 0x400FC000 synthesizes SCS.OSCSTAT and the two PLL0/PLL1 STAT.PLOCK bits so the busy-wait loops complete), generic/armcm_timer advances against the local DWT, and klippy completes its identify + clocksync handshake over the UART0 (NS16550) pty Renode exposes.
